audit_observation: The latest subscription is selected per customer using ROW_NUMBER with subscription_start_date and subscription_id ordering. The result covers 6,009 active customers across 21 normalized countries.

All 103,529 successful payments were mapped to subscriptions using customer ID and effective subscription date boundaries. The average is average payment amount, not average monthly revenue per customer.
The churn_labels table contains 8,000 unique customer records: 1,991 churned and 6,009 non-churned. Overall churn rate is 24.89%.
Acquisition channel analysis covers 8,000 unique customers across 8 channels. Distinct customer counts and churn-rate calculations were verified.
Historical plan memberships may count one customer under multiple plans. Interpret as historical membership, not exclusive current-plan population.
All 66,422 viewing rows have matching content records. No NULL or unmatched content IDs were found.
65,891 non-NULL completion values were found, ranging from 1 to 100. No out-of-range values or unmatched content records were found.
The latest payment month is May 2026. The 12-month reporting window contains failed payments in all 12 months, from June 2025 through May 2026.
All 4,592 Resolved/Closed tickets have resolution times. No negative resolution times were found.
All 4,592 Resolved/Closed tickets have non-NULL satisfaction scores within the observed 1-5 range.
Device labels normalized into standard categories. All 66,422 viewing rows have valid watch durations.
Feedback sentiment labels contain known intentional mislabelling. Treat sentiment averages cautiously.
All 8,000 customers have unique IDs and valid registration dates. Eight acquisition channels were found.
Latest-subscription ranking returns exactly 8,000 rows for 8,000 unique customers.
Ticket aggregation validated: 6,120 tickets across 4,408 customers. Exactly 120 customers have more than three tickets; maximum is seven.
There are 6,009 active subscription rows for 6,009 unique customers. No overlapping active subscriptions were found.

ROW_NUMBER uses ticket_date DESC NULLS LAST and ticket_id as a tie-breaker. However, 61 tickets have missing dates and 30 customers have only undated tickets. Their selected ticket cannot be verified as the latest by date.
Calendar-month diagnostic found no missing registration months in this dataset. The three-row moving average has consecutive observed calendar months for this dataset.
Corrected to compare the latest viewing month with the exact previous calendar month. Nonconsecutive observed months are no longer treated as consecutive.
Corrected to exclude customers whose 1-, 3- or 6-month retention milestone falls after the observation cutoff.
All 8,000 customers have country mappings across 21 normalized categories. Country churn rates and DENSE_RANK ordering were verified.
All 103,529 successful payments have unique payment IDs, valid customer IDs, payment dates and amounts. No negative amounts or duplicate ordering keys.
The query checks consecutive calendar months using month-date comparisons. It identified 1,447 declining three-month windows across 1,205 customers.

Historical activity is reconstructed using subscription start and cancellation dates with exclusive end boundaries. All 1,991 churn dates match cancellation dates. Forty-two records with cancellation dates before subscription start are excluded from the denominator.
Latest-subscription ranking returns 8,000 customer records: 6,009 Active and 1,991 Cancelled. No latest Active record has a non-NULL end date.
Lifetime successful spend was calculated for all 8,000 customers. NTILE(4) produces four equal groups of 2,000 customers each.
All 6,120 tickets have non-NULL, non-blank subcategories. Ranking returns exactly three subcategories for each of 21 countries, totaling 63 rows.
Failed-payment risk is a rule-based proxy, not a trained ML churn probability.
No historical subscription price changes were found. Zero rows are an expected dataset limitation, not an execution failure.

All 8,000 customers are represented and all 1,991 churned customers have churn dates and reasons. Successful payments after churn were found for 339 churned customers; the CLV query correctly excludes payments after the churn date.

Numeric normalization checks passed: 6,009 customers scored, no NULL or out-of-range scores. Uses CURRENT_DATE (system date 2026-10-30) while latest viewing data is 2026-06-30. Score is a rule-based risk proxy.

The most recent completed quarter is January-March 2026. It contains 586 tickets across 547 customers. All have subcategories, and the ranking returns exactly five complaints for each of 21 countries.
Corrected to restrict viewing activity to dates on or before churn_date before calculating last engagement.
Corrected to distinguish migration events from unique customers and calculate churn rate using distinct customers.
Weekly buckets are assigned to the month containing their Monday start date. Some weeks cross month boundaries; document this convention when interpreting WAU.
Negative sentiment labels are imperfect. Combining them with low ratings helps but does not eliminate label noise.

Score validation passed for 8,000 customers: no NULL or out-of-range scores and all normalized components are between 0 and 1. Uses CURRENT_DATE (2026-10-30) while latest viewing data is 2026-06-30. Feature weights are heuristic and predictive performance has not yet been established.

All 8,000 customers receive exactly one plan assignment, including all 1,991 churned customers at their churn dates. No tied latest subscription start dates were found. Forty-two customers have churn dates before the start of another subscription record.
